info.title: Project & Task Management API
info.description: REST API for a Jira/Trello-style project and task management system

owner.description: Admin only: assign a different Manager/Admin as owner

key.description: Issue-key prefix (e.g. "SUP" for SUP-101). Auto-derived from the name on first use if omitted.

boardType.description: Kanban hides the Backlog/Sprint-board/Calendar tabs client-side. Defaults to Scrum.

key.description: Issue-key prefix (e.g. "SUP" for SUP-101). Auto-derived from the name on first use if omitted.

boardType.description: Kanban hides the Backlog/Sprint-board/Calendar tabs client-side. Defaults to Scrum.

canEditAnyTask.description: Edit any task in this project, not just their own

canDeleteTask.description: Delete any task in this project

canChangeAnyTaskStatus.description: Transition any task's status, not just assigned tasks

wipLimit.description: WIP limit for this column on the board. Omit for no limit (default).

allowedRoles.description: Condition: who may trigger this transition. Omit/empty for "anyone" (default).

requireComment.description: Validator: the task must already have a comment before this transition is allowed.

requiredCustomFieldIds.description: Validator: custom field ids that must already have a value before this transition is allowed.

id.description: Omit when creating a new field - the server assigns a stable id. Include the existing id when editing a field's name/required/options.

hiddenFieldIds.description: Custom field ids to hide entirely for this issue type

requiredFieldIds.description: Custom field ids to force required=true for this issue type

optionalFieldIds.description: Custom field ids to force required=false for this issue type

fromStatus.description: Optional, only meaningful for StatusChanged - further scopes the trigger from "any status -> toStatus" to "fromStatus -> toStatus" (a specific workflow transition edge)

value.description: Status name (SetStatus), priority (SetPriority), user id (SetAssignee), comma-separated labels (AddLabels), or comment text supporting {{title}}/{{issueKey}}/{{status}} (AddComment).

id.description: Omit when creating a new rule - the server assigns a stable id. Include the existing id when editing a rule's name/enabled/trigger/conditions/actions.

entries.description: Empty resets the project to the system default policy

permissionSchemeId.description: null to unassign (fall back to default project permissions)

securitySchemeId.description: null to unassign (issues are then never view-restricted on this project)

allowedUserIds.description: User ids individually granted this action

allowedProjectRoleIds.description: Project Role ids granted this action (Module 6)

allowedUserIds.description: User ids individually granted view access

allowedProjectRoleIds.description: Project Role ids granted view access (Module 6)

issueType.description: One of the project's enabled issue types (the 5 built-ins, or a custom Standard-level type the Org Admin added) - validated against the project, not a fixed list.

parent.description: Epic-link (for Story/Task/Bug) or required parent (for Sub-task)

originalEstimateHours.description: Original Estimate in hours (Time Tracking & Work Logs)

components.description: Must be names already defined in the project's component list

customFieldValues.description: Keyed by the project's custom field ids. Value shape is validated per-field's type.

fixVersions.description: Release id(s) this issue targets ("Fix Version") - must belong to the project

affectsVersions.description: Release id(s) this issue affects ("Affects Version") - must belong to the project

securityLevel.description: A level name from the project's assigned Security Scheme (Module 6) - only valid when one is assigned; null means no view restriction.

sprintId.description: null moves every task back to the backlog

labels.description: Labels to add to every selected task

affectsVersions.description: Release id(s) this issue affects ("Affects Version") - must belong to the project

securityLevel.description: A level name from the project's assigned Security Scheme (Module 6) - only valid when one is assigned; null means no view restriction.

status.description: A status name from the task's project workflow (its custom workflow, or the system default). Legality is validated against that workflow, not a fixed enum.

sprintId.description: null moves the task back to the backlog

beforeTaskId.description: Omit to move to the top of the list

afterTaskId.description: Omit to move to the bottom of the list

endDate.description: Required unless durationWeeks is given (a custom date range).

durationWeeks.description: A preset sprint length (BRD 6.3) - when given, endDate is computed server-side (startDate + N weeks) and any client-supplied endDate is ignored.

capacityPoints.description: Team capacity in story points, for the planning capacity indicator.

capacityPoints.description: Team capacity in story points, for the planning capacity indicator.

nextSprintId.description: Where incomplete issues go (BRD 6.3's PM's choice) - omit/null for the default (the backlog); a Planned sprint id moves them there instead.

targetTaskId.description: The other task to link to

linkTypeId.description: One of the org's link-type ids

id.description: Omit when creating a new link type - the server assigns a stable id. Include the existing id when editing a type's name/inverseName/isBlocking.

isBlocking.description: Whether this type participates in circular-dependency detection
